name: Gold Champion
criteria: Official first-place finisher.

name: Silver Runner-Up
criteria: Official second-place finisher.

name: Bronze Racer
criteria: Official third-place finisher.

name: Speed Demon
criteria: Highest average WPM across the passage.

name: Fastest Fingers
criteria: Highest peak WPM in a rolling 5-second window.

name: Speed Over Power
criteria: Highest average WPM with accuracy ≥80% and <90%.

name: Quick Starter
criteria: Highest WPM over the first 20% of passage progress.

name: Perfectionist
criteria: Finish with 100% accuracy and zero incorrect attempts.

name: Sharp Shooter
criteria: Highest accuracy among finishers with at least one mistake.

name: Clean Run
criteria: Finish without incorrect characters, backspace or delete.

name: Steady Hands
criteria: Lowest standard deviation of accuracy over all ten passage sections.

name: Oops Factory
criteria: Most incorrect character attempts among finishers.

name: Keyboard Chaos
criteria: Highest mistakes per 100 attempts; at least 100 attempts.

name: Slow and Steady
criteria: Lowest average WPM among finishers.

name: Last but Persistent
criteria: Last finisher; at least two players must finish.

name: Comeback Kid
criteria: Largest positive rank gain from first reaching 20% to final rank.

name: Consistency King/Queen
criteria: Lowest coefficient of variation in 10-second WPM windows; ≥3 valid samples and positive mean.

name: Unstoppable
criteria: Complete three consecutive races in one lobby; repeat after another three.

name: Code Warrior
criteria: Highest Coding Mode score: average WPM × accuracy / 100.

name: Participation Trophy
criteria: Complete the passage and receive no other race trophy.
